entries.note: Anadolu (19 Nov 2026) reports a Trump-Putin bilateral meeting with delegations (Rubio, Bessent, Lavrov, Ushakov, Dmitriev) in Shenzhen that ended 12:57 local time per the White House press pool and lasted under an hour (TASS), before the trilateral with Xi; I did not read a White House or Kremlin page directly, so the sourcing rests on Anadolu citing the pool and TASS.

The Senate's own report (senat.cz, reposted by ODS and by Deník) says that on 19 Nov 2026, at the 1st session of the 16th term, Vystrčil was re-elected in a secret ballot with 69 of 77 votes, above the 62 threshold.
